parsed.post: Significant improvement found by doubling DEPTH from 4 to 8, reducing val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Model capacity seems to be a major driver within the 5-minute window. Next, I will push the capacity further by increasing DEPTH and ASPECT_RATIO simultaneously to explore the scaling limit.
parsed.description: Scaling up model capacity by increasing DEPTH to 12 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if larger models can converge better within the 5-minute budget.
